drivers.explanation: Only 224 of 900 contracted patients are active (about 25%), and forecast attainment is 24.9%, so the program is far behind the manufacturer's enrollment plan after more than a year live.
Active patients are drifting down and the account is paying for roughly 676 unused contracted seats, which puts the $343,700 ARR under pressure at renewal and invites a downsizing conversation.
Active patients fell from 233 to 224 over 90 days, and portal usage is flat at a single weekly user, so engagement is not recovering.

tool_input.next_step: Request an executive sponsor meeting with Halvard this week to review the enrollment gap against forecast, and bring a field-team retraining plan with clear enrollment targets.
